label: Indonesia
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels in Indonesia, across Bali's resort coastline and Jakarta's business districts.
intro: Indonesia's coverage in this directory spans two very different settings: Bali's beach and resort properties across the south of the island -- Nusa Dua's gated resort strip, Seminyak's beach-club scene, and inland stays near Ubud -- and Jakarta's business and diplomatic districts, from the Sudirman-Thamrin high-rise corridor to Mega Kuningan and the Central Jakarta shopping area.
